Printed with puzzle:
Stan Newman, a bond analyst from Brooklyn, New York, won the 1982 Grossinger's Crossword Weekend Tournament in Grossinger, New York, as well as the 1982 Annual American Crossword Puzzle Tournament in Stamford. For "training," he solved more than 1,500 crosswords last year. Stan completed this puzzle under test conditions in an intimidating 11 minutes 34 seconds. If he survives the eliminations, he'll be a top contender at the finals of the First U.S. Crossword Open, which Games will present at New York University on August 14.
